evidence_spans: The resulting configuration improves performance across all workloads, achieving 1.72×for training, 1.67×for serving, 4.76×for HPCG, and 2.61×for the coupled AI+HPC workload; FFT, at 1.37×, is the binding constraint.
A deterministic analytical evaluator closes the loop, ensuring that all performance estimates are derived from analytical models rather than generated by the LLM.
CLM-ARCH-0115.statement: The best agent-discovered design achieves a per-workload speedup of 2.61x for the coupled AI+HPC workload relative to the reference system.

extra_quotes: A deterministic analytical evaluator closes the loop, ensuring that all performance estimates are derived from analytical models rather than generated by the LLM.

The evaluator is a deterministic analytical model. Given a valid configuration, it returns the mixed-workload score, per-workload performance relative to the reference system, and an attribution of the dominant bottleneck among compute throughput, memory bandwidth, fabric latency, and bisection bandwidth.
The current model does not capture switch-level congestion, uses fixed factors for compute/communication overlap, and does not yet account for KV-cache transfer in disaggregated serving.
The wafer-scale archetype is approximated as a set of composable slices, which may underestimate intra-wafer bandwidth and overestimate inter-slice communication performance.
Similarly, the iso-cost analysis inherits uncertainty from publicly reported list prices.
